lines.speaker: Garden Child
lines.text: You went to the Prayer Root. I saw the light change.

lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: Gift was never meant to be a chain.

lines.speaker: Garden Child
lines.text: So love can wait for me without pulling?

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: Yes. Real love makes room for you to come back on your own feet.

lines.speaker: Garden Child
lines.text: Then I will try. Not because I was seized — because I was invited.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: The Father has always watched that way.
